texts.zh:
我们解码收集自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号的努力终见收获，我们终于能够和现在被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]的文明打开外交通讯频道了。

值得注意的是，他们是由一个单一的、强大的人工智能所指挥的全自动机器人文明。我们不知道任何他们创造者的迹象。我们只能假设他们在[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]发生智械危机的时候被清理干净了。
texts.en:
Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have paid off, and we are finally able to open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

Remarkably, it turns out that they are a fully-autonomous robotic civilization led by a single, formidable AI. We have seen no sign of their creators. We can only assume that they were wiped out in the cataclysm from which the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] emerged.

texts.zh:
我们解码收集自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号的努力终见收获，我们终于能够和现在被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]的文明打开外交通讯频道了。

值得注意的是，这些生物似乎是围绕某个分布式机械智能形成的合成人文明的一部分。在基本层面上，它们的意识本质与我们的并没有太大的不同。
texts.en:
Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have paid off, and we are finally able to open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

Remarkably, it appears these beings are part of a synthetic civilization which has formed around a distributed machine intelligence. At a fundamental level, the nature of their consciousness is not too dissimilar from our own.

texts.zh:
我们解码收集自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号的努力终见收获，我们终于能够和现在被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]的文明打开外交通讯频道了。

值得注意的是，他们是由一个单一的、强大的人工智能所指挥的全自动机器人文明。似乎这些机械对于挽救他们创造者的生命非常尽责。事实上[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]现在正被宠溺地作为“活体陈设”生活着，他们居住在被特殊设计的“有机庇护所”之中，在那里他们显然只需要做爱做的事情就好……
texts.en:
Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have paid off, and we are finally able to open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

Remarkably, it turns out that they are a fully-autonomous robotic civilization led by a single, formidable AI. It appears that, though the machines are very much in charge, they have spared the lives of their creators. Indeed, the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural] now live their lives as pampered "Bio-Trophies" in specially designated "Organic Sanctuaries", where their only job is, apparently, to be themselves...

texts.zh:
我们解码收集自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号的努力终见收获，我们终于能够和现在被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]的文明打开外交通讯频道了。

值得注意的是，他们是由一个单一的、强大的人工智能所指挥的全自动机器人文明。和我们最大的不同在于它们保留了有机物种[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]，并将其圈养在特有的庇护所之中。这些生物似乎是他们的创造者的后裔，出于某种我们无法理解的原因被娇惯保护着。
texts.en:
Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have paid off, and we are finally able to open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

Remarkably, it turns out that they are a fully-autonomous robotic civilization led by a single, formidable AI. Where they differ most from us is in keeping an organic species, the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural], isolated in special sanctuaries. These beings appear to be descendants of the machines' creators, now coddled and preserved for reasons beyond our understanding.

texts.zh:
我们解码收集自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号的努力终见收获，我们终于能够和现在被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]的文明打开外交通讯频道了。

值得注意的是，他们是由一个单一的、强大的人工智能所指挥的全自动机器人文明。似乎这些机械并不希望浪费他们创造者的潜能，即[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]。相反地，他们通过对创造者植入义体元件以将他们同化进自己的集体之中。令人不安的是，我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]找不到任何理由相信这种植入体对我们的物种会不起作用……
texts.en:
Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have paid off, and we are finally able to open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

Remarkably, it turns out that they are a fully-autonomous robotic civilization led by a single, formidable AI. It appears that the machines did not wish to waste the potential of their creators, the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural]. Instead, they found a way to assimilate them into their collective by implanting them with cybernetics. Disturbingly, our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] see no reason to believe that such implants would not work on our own population...

texts.zh:
我们解码收集自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号的努力终见收获，我们终于能够和现在被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]的文明打开外交通讯频道了。

值得注意的是，他们是由一个单一的、强大的人工智能所指挥的全自动机器人文明。似乎这些机械并不希望浪费他们创造者的潜能，即[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]。相反地，他们通过对创造者植入义体元件以将他们同化进自己的集体之中。幸运的是，我们认为我们的子个体并不会脆弱到被这种植入体所控制。
texts.en:
Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have paid off, and we are finally able to open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

Remarkably, it turns out that they are a fully-autonomous robotic civilization led by a single, formidable AI. It appears that the machines did not wish to waste the potential of their creators, the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural]. Instead, they found a way to assimilate them into their collective by implanting them with cybernetics. Fortunately, we believe that our own drones possess no such vulnerability and would instead be rendered inoperative by the implants.

texts.zh:
我们解码收集自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号的努力终见收获，我们终于能够和现在被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]的文明打开外交通讯频道了。

值得注意的是，他们是由一个单一的、强大的人工智能所指挥的全自动机器人文明。然而，他们找到了某种在自身结构中保留部分有机成分的理由：[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]，他们的固有意识似乎被机器思维所包容。

尽管它会对大多数有机物种构成威胁，但我们怀疑，如果这个义体人帝国试图同化我们，他们会发现我们的共生体不足以成为子个体。
texts.en:
Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have paid off, and we are finally able to open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

Remarkably, it turns out that they are a fully-autonomous robotic civilization led by a single, formidable AI. They have, however, found means of retaining some organic elements to their structure: the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural], whose inherent consciousness appears subsumed by the machine mind.

Despite the threat this would pose to most organic species, we suspect our symbionts would prove to be inadequate drones if this cyborg empire ever attempted to assimilate us.

label.zh: 我们应该研究他们——或许我们自己的自动化系统可以得到升级！
label.en: We should study them - perhaps our own automation could be upgraded!

label.zh: 恐怖。我们必须找到拆除它们的办法！
label.en: Terrifying. We must find out how to dismantle them!
